title: Successor formula for the layer offset
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit of depth $d$ using only the standard gate operations, and let its offset at $m$ be the sum of the numbers of nodes in layers $j+1$ for $j<m$, counting zero when $j\ge d$. Then for every natural number $m$, the offset at $m+1$ is the offset at $m$ plus the number of nodes in layer $m+1$ if $m<d$, and is just the offset at $m$ otherwise.
